meta.title: Kawalyser
meta.pageTitle: Keyboard layout analyser with 1DK and Magic keys · Kawalyser

about.title: Test a keyboard layout before you learn it
about.intro: Learning a new keyboard layout takes weeks. Kawalyser first tells you if it is comfortable. It types a long French or English text on your layout and counts how your fingers move.
measures: Scissors, lateral stretches and row jumps.
Hand alternation, inward and outward rolls, and redirects.
The load on each finger and each hand.
features: Split keyboards with 34 or 40 keys, letters under the thumbs included.
A dead key (1DK) for accented letters and symbols.
Repeat and Magic keys, and Clever Keys rules from a replacements file.
Kalamine .toml import, drag-and-drop editing and CSV export.
